items.reason: Clear parentage question; “Abimelek son of Jerub-Baal” directly supports the answer.
Direct action question, supported by “rebuilt Elath and restored it to Judah.”
“Micah think” introduces one clear belief layer. His stated reason is “since this Levite has become my priest.”
“另一个妇人” is identifiable from the reporting woman's account. “明天我们就吃我的儿子” supports D, and the time choices are distinct.
The question clearly asks who took the listed objects. “那五个窥探地的人进去，拿了” directly supports C; the choices require no list comparison.
Clear giver–recipient question; the passage says he gave the commanders “the spears and shields that had belonged to King David.”
Direct actor question. “他暗暗打发人” refers clearly to “示剑的官西布,” making B the unique supported choice.
Clear causal question; “由于保罗第二天准备离开” directly supports A.
Direct construction question; “built towers in Jerusalem at the Corner Gate, at the Valley Gate” supports the target answer, towers.
Simple, unambiguous object question. Micah acknowledges taking “the eleven hundred shekels of silver.”
